report.question:
own-git-invocation-policy, round 4. The task was resumed with the decision 'I will decide the git source and revise the artifacts myself', but the artifacts are unchanged: design.md:324-326, proposal.md:207 and :235, and tasks.md 8.4 (line 294) and 8.5 (line 303) still name the git-core PPA as the source of git >= 2.56. The PPA still has only 1:2.55.0 (Launchpad API, rechecked today for jammy, noble, resolute and stonking). .claude/rules/testing.md has no local-config posture paragraph yet, so 4.2 also stays unticked (proposed text: temporary-docs/gnomish/github-oinsio-gnomish-factory-102/testing-md-proposal.md).

Done this round:
(a) Task 8.5, every part that does not depend on the git source: ADR 0008 and 0012, threat registry rows 48 and 50, the operator guide, docs/examples/sandbox-image, developer-guide, and a release note with Homebrew as the remedy and no claim about the PPA. Only the Ubuntu remedy is left.
(b) A defect in task 8.2, found and fixed: GitInvocation.HOOK_EVENTS lacked the four git-p4 events (p4-changelist, p4-prepare-changelist, p4-post-changelist, p4-pre-submit) that githooks(5) of 2.56.0 lists. Design D3 asks for every event on that page. There are now 28 events and 36 pairs. Specs are green and PIT kills all mutants. design.md:338 says '37 in all', but the page gives 8 + 28 = 36.

Still open: 4.2 (testing.md), 8.4 (CI git source), the Ubuntu line of 8.5, and 8.7 (the final check, which needs 8.4). The working copy still has the PPA steps in ci.yml and pitest-nightly.yml, and the Dockerfile check at >= 2.56. Nothing else can move until the artifacts name a git source and testing.md gets the paragraph.
options: Artifacts and testing.md are now revised: implement 8.4/8.5/8.7 as they read now
Use Homebrew git in CI and the Linux runner; I have revised (or authorize revising) D11/UX3/8.4/8.5 accordingly and applied testing.md
Wait: I am still revising the artifacts; resume me when done
